class.name: HumanoidControlRig3D
class.brief_description: Creates basic humanoid control targets and skeleton modifiers from an imported skeleton.
class.description: [HumanoidControlRig3D] is a helper node for characters imported from formats such as glTF or FBX. Add it as a child of a [Skeleton3D], then call [method setup_from_skeleton] to create generated [Marker3D] controls and [SkeletonModifier3D] children for hand IK, foot IK, and head look-at. This node does not import models and does not use proprietary character data formats. It only reads the existing [Skeleton3D] bone hierarchy and configures built-in Godot nodes such as [TwoBoneIK3D] and [LookAtModifier3D]. Generated nodes are named with the [code]ControlRig_[/code] prefix and can be removed with [method clear_generated_rig].

method.name: clear_generated_rig
method.description: Removes nodes generated by this control rig. Only child nodes with the [code]ControlRig_[/code] prefix are removed.

method.name: get_control_node
method.description: Returns a generated control node by logical name, such as [code]&"hand_l"[/code], [code]&"foot_r"[/code], or [code]&"head_look"[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the control was not generated.

method.name: get_missing_bones
method.description: Returns the bone groups that were requested but not found during the last [method setup_from_skeleton] call.

method.name: setup_from_skeleton
method.description: Finds common humanoid bone names on the parent [Skeleton3D], creates control [Marker3D] nodes, and configures generated [TwoBoneIK3D] and [LookAtModifier3D] nodes. Calling this method multiple times first clears previous generated nodes.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], [method setup_from_skeleton] is called when the node enters the scene tree.
Scales the initial placement offsets for generated pole and look-at controls.
If [code]true[/code], [method setup_from_skeleton] creates foot IK controls when matching leg bones are found.
If [code]true[/code], [method setup_from_skeleton] creates hand IK controls when matching arm bones are found.
If [code]true[/code], [method setup_from_skeleton] creates a head look-at control when a matching head bone is found.
